headline: YPF Pricing Mechanism Prevents 57% Spike in Argentine Fuel Prices
summary: An IARAF study shows state-backed oil firm YPF's pricing buffer prevented Argentine gasoline pump prices from surging up to 57%. Without interventions, fuel costs would have approached 3,000 pesos per liter.
why: YPF SA is Argentina's dominant state-controlled energy producer and distributor, setting local energy market pricing standards.

impacts.name: YPF S.A.
impacts.why: Price absorption buffer policies cap domestic fuel revenues during global crude spikes.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
